text:
Ellen (People Ops): quick check  urgent offer exception for senior IC (candidate name: Ana Lopez). Hiring wants expedited comp-band uplift + accelerated equity vesting to match counteroffer. Candidate aiming to start 2026-06-01 and needs benefits day-one. Packet: https://redwood-internal/hr/offers/ana-lopez
Diego (Hiring Manager): Ana is a strong ML infra hire. Current L6 comp won't hold. Asking provisional L7 for first 120 days, then review. Also requesting 25% of next year RSU vest front-loaded at hire.
Pri (Recruiter): candidate received competing offer with sign-on and 12-month accelerated RSU. Ana asked if we can match partial acceleration and earlier benefits.
Samira (Finance): what's the total cost delta? need base, sign-on, equity acceleration estimate, GL and budget owner.
Ellen (People Ops): proposed figures:
``
Proposed provisional base: $245,000 (from $220k)
Sign-on: $40,000 (paid 60% at start, 40% at 6 months)
Equity acceleration: 25% of 2027 grant vested immediately (est value $45,000)
Benefits effective: 2026-06-01 (first day)
Rationale: retention risk + immediate project impact
``
Ken (Comp Reviewer): uplift >$20k needs comp-committee approval. Equity acceleration requires exec OK and Legal review. Please add peer comp spreadsheet and manager statement.
Pri (Recruiter): uploading comps and manager note: https://redwood-internal/docs/comp-justifications/ana-lopez-2026.pdf
Olga (Payroll): note payroll cutoff: hires entered by 5pm PT on the day before payroll run get benefits same-month; otherwise they go next month. If start is 06/01 and paperwork delays, we can request benefits retroactive but that requires finance provisioning. Bridging stipend possible.
Samira (Finance): initial delta: base uplift $25k => recurring cost; sign-on & equity non-recurring. Need GL 6101.3000 and budget owner eng-infra. With comp approval and Legal text, finance can provision.
Legal (Legal): advise: equity acceleration ok with standard vesting amendment and clawback: "If employee voluntarily departs within 12 months, accelerated equity is forfeited or prorated as defined." Also need to confirm tax withholding for accelerated grant; will attach amendment.
hr-bot: policy reminder: "Equity acceleration >$25k requires VP signoff and tax escrow review" (policy HR-EQ-011). Template: /templates/equity-accel-amend-v1.docx
Diego (Hiring Manager): can VP Eng sign off today if comp-committee clears? Need to send by EOD to lock candidate.
Ellen (People Ops): routing plan: comp-committee -> finance -> legal -> VP Eng final. I'll route now to comp-committee@redwood.com and include all docs and GL. Target EOD.
Ken (Comp Reviewer): scheduling fast-track review now. If docs complete I'll approve.
Samira (Finance): marked approved pending Legal amendment. GL and budget owner confirmed.
Legal (Legal): uploaded signed amendment and tax note.
Ken (Comp Reviewer): comp-committee approved (fast-track) with note: provisional for 120 days, review at 90 days for permanent placement.
Diego (Hiring Manager): thanks all. Pri will send final offer and candidate prefers start 2026-06-01.
Olga (Payroll): confirmed benefits setup for 06/01 once docs are in by 5pm PT on 05/31. If delayed, Payroll will flag for bridging stipend.
Ellen (People Ops): final: finance and legal have approved, comp-committee signed, VP Eng gave verbal ok in DM. Offer to be sent at 15:30 PT. Closing thread after signed acceptance. :party_parrot:
